methodology.corpus: TRAIN + VALIDATION evidence_text only, deduped by evidence_norm (8250 unique passages). TEST evidence is never indexed.
methodology.queries: TEST split claim_text only (held out, never used to tune anything).
methodology.ground_truth: A query's gold document is its own evidence_norm string, looked up in the corpus. Queries whose gold evidence is absent from the TRAIN+VALIDATION corpus are excluded (metric undefined), not scored as misses. See module docstring for the full native-vs-backfilled explanation.
methodology.native_vs_backfilled: native = AraStance (independently-authored article per claim, genuine ground truth). backfilled = VERA-ARAB / ArCOV19-tweets / ArCOV19-claims (evidence_text was itself selected by a prior TF-IDF retrieval step during Phase 1 restoration -- weaker evidence of true relevance; see hackathon/restore_claim_training_fast.py).
methodology.structural_finding: 0 of 169 AraStance / 0 of 638 ArCOV19(-tweets/-claims) TEST rows have their gold evidence present in the TRAIN+VALIDATION corpus (each claim's article is essentially unique, never reused across claims/splits) vs. 1428 of 3193 (44.7%) for VERA-ARAB (evidence drawn from a shared, reusable passage pool). Consequently NATIVE metrics below are N=0 (not computable under the leakage-respecting corpus constraint), and 'backfilled'/'pooled' numbers are, in effect, VERA-ARAB-only numbers. This is reported explicitly rather than pooling it away.
methodology.recall_hitrate_equivalence: Every query has exactly one gold relevant document, so Recall@K and HitRate@K are numerically identical here; both are reported for completeness, not as independent signals.
methodology.sample_reduction: Evaluable TEST queries (gold evidence present in TRAIN+VALIDATION corpus) = 1428 of 4000 total TEST rows. Of these, 0 are native (AraStance) and 1428 are backfilled (VERA-ARAB / ArCOV19-tweets / ArCOV19-claims). To stay within the ~20-30 minute compute budget for this hackathon task, the backfilled-evaluable pool was downsampled with a FIXED SEED (42) from 1428 to 500 queries (cap=500). The native-evaluable pool (0) was used in full (no reduction needed).

validation_only_tuning_check.decision: kept existing defaults (bm25_weight=0.5, dense_weight=0.5, RRF k=60); no strong validation-set signal to justify retuning within the hackathon time budget
